pages.title: Sixfold Staff
pages.text: Sneak-use to choose a voice; use to cast. Earth slows foes, Fire strikes and ignites for 4 seconds, Water heals and cleanses, Air grants a short leap and slow falling, Spirit reveals enemies within 12 blocks, Loom tethers a foe up to 8 blocks toward you or, sneaking with no target, stitches you 6 blocks forward.

pages.title: Staff costs
pages.text: Earth 12, Fire 18, Water 24, Air 16, Spirit 20 Pulse; Loom 6 to tether (up to 8 blocks), 10 to stitch (6 blocks). Water rests for 8 seconds; other voices for 2. Stitch rests 1.5 seconds. Offensive spells reach 18 blocks, target hostile creatures, and stop at solid obstacles.

pages.title: Resonance Maul
pages.text: Hold the maul in your main hand. Sneak-use a stone face to excavate a 3-by-3 plane. Each block costs 8 Pulse. Tool requirements and normal player block protection still apply. If Pulse runs out mid-swing, remaining blocks stay. The maul then rests one second.

pages.title: Spiritweave
pages.text: Unlinked hood: night sight. Robe: resistance. Leggings: speed. Boots: slow falling when descending. Unlinked pieces spend 2 Pulse every four seconds; a bound voice spends 3. Sneak-use a piece on a placed Resonance Totem with 40 Pulse to replace that boon with the totem's voice.

pages.title: Ritual Brazier
pages.text: Seat a reusable elemental seal. With its matching totem and Pulse nearby, the brazier sustains a blessing for players within 6 blocks. It spends 8 Pulse every two seconds. Standing blessings do not need a circle. Tablet rites do: four Rite Pedestals on the diagonals and chalk joining them.

pages.title: Camp blessings
pages.text: Earth grants haste; Fire resists flame; Water regenerates; Air slows falls; Spirit grants night sight; Loom grants luck and threads 2 Pulse into a carried cell each beat. Redstone pauses the brazier. Sneak empty-handed to recover its seal.

pages.title: Tablet rites
pages.text: Sneak-use a tablet on a Ritual Brazier with the matching seal seated, inside its Rite Circle. Missing pedestals or chalk name the circle and spend nothing. Pulse comes from generators within 8, not a cell in your pocket. Rain Calling (Water, 400) lasts 20 minutes; Sky Clearing (Air, 400) lasts 40. Dawn Calling is Fire and 800. Green Blessing (Earth, 600) covers nine chunks for 20 minutes. Still Night (Spirit, 600) hushes hostiles within 64 blocks for 15 minutes. Ley Binding (Loom, 1,200) ties two totems within 64 blocks for 30 minutes.

pages.title: Spring Calling
pages.text: Every tablet rite needs the Rite Circle, including this one. Seat the Water Seal, place a Spirit Cistern beside the brazier, sneak-use the tablet. Spend 300 Pulse. The cistern fills 100 mB a second for ten minutes. You do not have to stand there. Moving the cistern ends the spring; water already inside stays on the item.

pages.title: Grove Tender
pages.text: Place it yourself at crop height in the middle of a 9-by-9 plot so it is claimed. An unclaimed tender will not tend. 4 Pulse to plant, 12 to harvest, 16 to urge growth. A lever pauses work.

pages.title: Offering Table
pages.text: A 27-slot camp store. Hoppers and pipes work on every side. A comparator reads fullness. Redstone locks the menu and automation. Standing and favoured offerings go on the Tribe Hearth, not this table.

pages.title: Rain Chime
pages.text: Reports world weather as a comparator signal: 8 for rain, 15 for thunder, 0 for clear skies. It does not make Pulse. A roof does not mute it. Redstone mutes it and sets the output to zero.

pages.title: Pulse lights
pages.text: Glow Reed, Shard Lamp and Echo Sconce draw 1 Pulse a second from nearby generators; Ember Bowl draws 2. They have no buffer and go dark without Pulse. Redstone dims them. A comparator reads 15 while lit. Hang an Echo Sconce on a wall. Spirit Lanterns still light with no Pulse. A Wind Charm hangs from a sturdy ceiling, has no collision, pops without a ceiling, and spends no Pulse.

pages.title: Standing
pages.text: Offer at a Tribe Hearth: favoured +3, reagent +8, food +1, Pulse Cell +2 per 10 Pulse (at most 40 Pulse, +8). One hearth grants at most 60 standing a day from offerings. Kills within 24 give +1, twenty per day. A trade gives +2. Guest 50, Friend 150, Kin 400, Voice 800. Hurting Kin costs 25; a hearth 40; a banner 5.

pages.title: Tribal Kin
pages.text: Elder trades at Guest. Two offers per rank; stock restocks once per Minecraft day. Drummer every 6 seconds feeds 2 Pulse into a Drumheart, Ley Collector or Pulse Resonator within 8. Hunter strikes hostiles within 12, and you for a minute if you hurt Kin. Weaver works a loom or Song Bench for six seconds. Kin wander 16 and never despawn.

pages.title: Hush Totem
pages.text: Suppresses hostile spawning within 24 blocks for 8 Pulse a second. A 2,400-Pulse reserve bridges interruptions; nearby generators refill up to 80 Pulse a second. Covers natural and spawner-born hostiles, including Summoning Cradles. It does not remove existing mobs. Redstone silences it immediately.

pages.title: Wayanchor
pages.text: Holds one chunk for 16 Pulse a second. A 2,400-Pulse reserve bridges interruptions; nearby generators refill up to 80 Pulse a second. Up to 32 anchors per dimension, or twelve shared by a camp. Redstone or an empty reserve releases the ticket.

pages.title: Bonding Charm
pages.text: Gentle animals: three tries in five succeed; the charm is kept on failure. Remnants: two tries in five; the charm is spent on failure, and Voice standing with their tribe is required. Success does not reroll the lattice. Follows within ten blocks and teleports past twelve. Quiet Thread follows from eight and stops at two.

pages.title: Spirit Charms
pages.text: Three worn slots. Worn cost is 2 Pulse per voice every two seconds. A silent Chorus still costs 2. Chorus bind: three different totems within 8 and 200 Pulse at a Ritual Brazier. Extra sneak-uses on totems add voices for 40 Pulse each. Spindle is luck, and about three times in ten it refunds up to 2 Pulse into a carried cell every two seconds. Ward turns aside about one projectile in four, or one in two if Spirit is also on the charm.

pages.title: Spiritgear ranks
pages.text: Attune (Fire) 0 to 1: 8 seconds and 24 Pulse a second before pack settings. Bind (Water) 1 to 2: 10 seconds and 32 Pulse a second. Manifest (Spirit) 2 to 3: 12 seconds and 40 Pulse a second. You cannot skip. Rank 1 cheapens action Pulse by one: mining costs 2, a hit costs 3, a use costs 1 (floor 1). Rank 2 skips the extra hurt when starved. Rank 3 mines at netherite speed. A Loom-linked pick already spends 0 Pulse to mine. Bound armor: Earth hood turns aside one projectile in five (about one in three at rank 3). Fire robe ignites attackers for 3 seconds. Spirit robe makes attackers glow. Water robe regenerates (longer at rank 3). Air robe ignores knockback. Earth boots cut knockback and do not trample farmland. Spirit boots cancel fall (rank 3 bounce from a high drop). Loom boots sneak-stitch 4 blocks, or 6 at rank 3, then rest 8 seconds.

pages.title: Summoning Cradle
pages.text: Imprint an exhausted Binding Effigy on an eligible creature. Awaken it at a Spirit-sealed Brazier with Earth, Air and Spirit, 200 Pulse and three Spiritweave: 512 threads. The cradle every ten seconds spends 80 Pulse, one Spiritweave and one thread on a clear dry floor within three blocks. Eight nearby mobs pause it. An imprint alone has no summons.
